question.text: The rate constant for a first order reaction is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><msup><mi>min</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. (Nearest integer)

solution.text:
For a first order reaction, we know:
t1/2=0.693k=0.69320=0.03465 min
From the relation of half lives(where 'n' is the no. of half-lives):
